title: K J Pike Sons
description: kjpike.co.uk K J Pike and Sons Ltd is a British family run trolley maintenance company founded in 1976 near Blandford Forum, Dorset, England. Owned and led by the Pike family, Kenneth John Pike holds significant control and Duncan Pike is managing director. It claims to be the leading trolley maintenance provider in the UK, repairing, refurbishing and servicing supermarket trolleys, roll cages, Tetretainers, airport luggage trolleys, mobility equipment and pump trucks nationwide. Its 4.5 acre site with 75000 square feet of warehousing is the largest in the industry, storing up to 130000 trolleys, and it runs 12 trucks and 15 trailers under a Standard National operator licence valid to 2028. Around 28 employees work on repairs, storage, transport and trolley security systems, with mobile engineers providing on site maintenance across Britain. Financially solid with 1.2 million pounds working capital in 2024, the company also sponsors horse races like the K J Pike and Sons.
